question: Which of the following group of organisms are involved in the breakdown of dead and decaying organisms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Decomposers**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Decomposers are the group of organisms that break down dead and decaying organisms**
 
• **Decomposers break down dead organisms **into simpler substances, releasing nutrients and carbon into the soil.
 
• These nutrients are then used by primary producers and plants.
 
• **Bacteria and fungi **are examples of decomposers
 
• **Decomposers play a vital role in the flow of energy through an ecosystem**.
 
• They make up the largest population in the food chain. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Consumers:**

 
 
• Organisms that cannot produce their own food and rely on other organisms for nutrition.
 
• Examples: Herbivores (eat plants), carnivores (eat animals), omnivores (eat both plants and animals).
 
 
 
• **Producers:**
 
 
• Organisms that can produce their own food through photosynthesis or chemosynthesis.
 
• Examples: Plants, algae, bacteria.
 
 
 
• **Scavengers:**
 
 
• Organisms that consume dead or decaying organic matter.
 
• Examples: Vultures, hyenas, crows.
